about: A known-size, asymmetric orientation fixture in meters, Z up, right-handed. It is the union of these boxes (min and max corners). Its bounding box is 0.30 x 0.20 x 0.10; the tall block sits at -X, the tab points to +Y, so a swapped axis, a mirrored axis, or a unit mistake each move a number the contract check compares.
